title: BA1/587/2014 of Amritpal Vs State Of Uttarakhand

paras.text:
BA-1 No.587 of 2014
Hon'ble U.C.Dhyani, J.
 Although, the Lawyers are
abstaining from Court work, as there
is a resolution of Bar Council of
India, but since the correction
application is formal in nature,
therefore, the same is taken up even in
the absence of the parties.
 Correction application is
allowed. The amendment sought for is
also is allowed.
 Let the correction, as prayed, be
incorporated in the bail application,
and, thereafter, in the order passed by
this Court.
 MCRC No. 40/2015 thus stands
disposed of.
